title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. translated_title: 从交互到能力：以任务推进作为GUI智能体的状态与监督
translated_abstract: GUI记忆应当保存过去动作的结果并学习可复用的操作。这在长时程工作流中非常困难，因为智能体需要跨应用程序利用信息，且有用的操作往往与失败的尝试交织在一起。我们提出了任务推进记忆（Task Advancement Memory, TAM），它将任务推进定义为经验证的任务进展，既支持正在进行的任务执行，也学习可复用的操作。在执行过程中，任务推进状态刻画了经验证的任务进展如何改变剩余目标，使智能体能够基于跨应用程序的早期成果继续推进。在每个任务完成后，推进监督会识别并抽象出那些产生了经验证局部结果的交互。所学到的操作保留了所需输入、预期结果与验证条件之间的关系。这使得无论任务最终成功还是失败，其中局部成功的操作都能被保留下来。在MobileWorld纯GUI任务上，该（原文此处被截断）
tldr: 提出任务推进记忆（TAM），将经验证的任务进展同时作为执行过程中的状态和任务结束后的监督信号，使GUI智能体能够在长时程跨应用工作流中积累可复用操作，并从成功与失败的任务中学习局部有效的经验。
en_tdlr: We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which uses verified task progress both as an execution state and as post-task supervision, enabling GUI agents to accumulate reusable operations from successful and failed tasks in long-horizon cross-application workflows.
